lines.t: You said I kept the rules I gave when I asked and sang the song
You said your hands were clean, your house in order, why must I be so hard?
I heard the words you wore like rose, the tidy prayers you gave
I watched the lamps you trimmed
Felt seats you warmed with faith
Yet this word I said before you
Is a plumb line straight and true
My alarm to wake the sleeper
And correction when you
I do not hunger for your show
I hunger for a willing heart
I ask for all not scraps
Give me your hands and do not keep me apart
My arms are open but you keep me at arm's length
This call is for the humble who answer without restraint
Give directly to the poor when I skip drink and cloak and bread
Tide not just coin but strength and time
Lay down the comforts that you've led
Walk the path of sacrifice
This is the way my people prove
Not public praise, no simple sermons
But yielding in me move
You say, why, Lord, must I lose
The things I hold so tight
My child, I'm prone to bring forth fruit
Let go, beloved, take flight
Pour out all what you would not give
Lay yourself upon my stone and truly live
The least among you here and run
The poor, the meek, the one who's bare
The widow, thief in sorrow, lame and weary
My table waits for all who cares
Come out before the time
Be plucked up, escape what must soon take place
I do not hunger for your show
I hunger for a willing heart
I ask for all, not scraps
Give me your hands and do not keep me apart
My arms are open but you keep me at arm's length
This call is for the humble
Who answer without restraint
Once will be love
Once will be love
I weep yet I call
My heart is not glad
It hardened stone
If you will come
You will be found
If not
The door must close
Harden not your heart
Come out and find your rest
The fields are wide
The harvest waits
Here with ears to hear
Hear me
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh The first will be light
What did I withhold from you, beloved?
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh I surrendered all to you in my passion
Oh, oh, oh
The first will be last
Oh, oh, oh
Oh, oh, oh
The last will be first
